== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[The Last Horizon]] is a powerful entity characterized as both a massive, floating city and a dark metal starship known as the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]]. It possesses legendary capabilities, including the ability to terraform environments, [[construct]] entire fleets, and utilize teleportation magic that could potentially be used for planetary [[destruction]]. The entity is equipped with devastating weaponry, such as particle beams, [[plasma cannons]], [[proton bombs]], and seeker missiles, capable of leveling cities. While it has a history of defending planets from threats like the [[D’Niss]], its true allegiances remain unclear. This ambiguity has led to widespread rumors across various galactic factions that the ship is a harbinger of disaster and a terror to both the [[Union]] and the [[Free Worlds]]. Despite its reputation for [[destruction]], its core mandate is focused on galactic security and protecting civilization from various governmental threats. The entity operates with a crew, including an [[Engineer]], and is capable of maneuvering through intense combat scenarios against various hostile forces.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Located on the planet Fathom, Planetary [[Security]] maintains control over the local airspace. This entity is supported by the [[Magic Tower]] and manages various administrative duties, such as maintaining a database and issuing docking passes. While they have previously waved militia starships through the orbital cordon, they received an alert simultaneously with [[Sola Kalter|Sola]]. Ultimately, the organization experienced a period of panic on Fathom.}}
